name: longhaul
description: Longhaul's own marketplace, this repository: the longhaul plugin, and longhaul-advisor, its Advisor experiment (off unless the owner enables it).

plugins.name: longhaul
plugins.description: Keep the thread in long Claude Code sessions: Claude saves where it is, Longhaul compacts, and the work picks up after a compaction, a resume or /clear. Shows where the tokens go.

plugins.name: longhaul-advisor
plugins.description: Longhaul's Advisor experiment: the /longhaul-advisor:advise skill and the read-only advisor agent it consults. Needs the longhaul plugin, whose hook checks, caps and traces every consultation. Off unless the owner enables the experiment.
